title: Parking with Frustrated Drivers
summary: Imagine there are $n$ cars lined up along a one-way street containing $n$ spots. Each car contains a group of friends, including a reluctant driver. Each car has a preferred spot and cars enter one by one. The cars drive to their preferred spot and if it is empty park there. If it is not empty, a friend in the back yells out ``Hey! You should have driven faster!". Frustrated by this, the driver continues down the road until they find the last unoccupied spot (if one exists) and parks there.
